map.会。分红减少留存收益（净资产）且不减少股本，BVPS 下降；但股价除权同步下调，: Yes. A dividend reduces retained earnings (net assets) without reducing the share count, so BVPS falls; but the share price adjusts ex-dividend by the same amount, so P/B is unchanged.

map.通常用归属于母公司股东的净资产（剔除少数股东），口径需与 P/B 分母一致，否则: Usually the net assets attributable to the parent company shareholders (excluding minority interests) are used; the basis must match the denominator of P/B, otherwise the ratio is distorted.
map.：BVPS = 股东权益/总股本 = 10 亿 / 2 亿 = 5.00 元/股: : BVPS = shareholders equity / total shares = 1 billion / 200 million = 5.00 CNY per share. At a share price of 30 CNY, P/B = 6.
